en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,610 | Coding agents usually **forget everything** once a session ends, forcing you to repeat instructions. Claude-Mem runs a silent second agent to **take notes**, compresses the activity, and automatically injects relevant context into your future sessions.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为所有 AI 编程助手提供跨会话的持久化记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,610 | AI 编程助手每次对话结束后就会**失忆**，导致你得重复提供背景。Claude-Mem 在后台运行第二个 AI 默默**做笔记**，把干过的事压缩后，自动喂给未来的新会话。

en.title: Do AI entrepreneurs still have a chance with Personal Agents?
en.summary: Personal Agents are all the rage, but many believe this game belongs solely to big tech giants. However, the true value of Personal Agents doesn't rely on the underlying foundation model. By focusing on personal context and specific vertical scenarios, founders can build unique assets beyond the base model and find their own survival path.

zh.title: 创业者做 Personal Agent，有没有一线生机？
zh.summary: Personal Agent 现在非常火，但大家普遍觉得这是大厂的游戏，创业者没戏。其实，这类产品的终极价值并不完全依赖底层大模型。只要找准具体垂直场景，沉淀用户信任和上下文，创业者依然能跳出大模型的影子，在激烈竞争中抓住一线生机。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Multi-Agent Systems
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have put together **15 design patterns** for building reliable AI multi-agent systems. These patterns help developers handle **complex tasks** by breaking them down and making multiple AI agents work together smoothly.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合公开：AI多Agent系统的15个设计模式
zh.summary: GitHub、谷歌和西门子联合总结了 **15个设计模式**，用来教大家怎么设计靠谱的AI多Agent系统。这些模式能帮开发者把 **复杂任务** 拆开，让多个AI助手像团队一样配合干活。

en.title: Beating DeepSeek to the punch, a Silicon Valley Chinese team builds the next-gen AI Agent harness
en.summary: DeepSeek recently proposed the Super-agent concept, but a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI actually beat them to it by months with their product Comma. Designed to solve the bottleneck where humans struggle to manage multiple AI chats, this system uses a **single router and multi-worker** architecture. It allows users to handle complex, cross-app tasks through a **single persistent conversation**, freeing humans from juggling windows and letting AI agents manage themselves.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人把下一代Agent Harness造出来了
zh.summary: DeepSeek最近提出了超级智能体理念，但一家名为AFK AI的硅谷华人团队其实早几个月就已经在产品Comma里做出来了。为了解决人类根本看不过来多个AI对话的痛点，这套系统采用了**主脑加多执行者**的架构。用户只需要在一个**长期存在的对话框**里交代任务，AI就能自己派活干活，把人类从切窗口的痛苦中解放出来。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to help robots learn and test physical skills like pushing, flipping, and stacking blocks. By combining **controlled environments** with automatic task generation, the framework allows scientists to easily study why robot models succeed or fail, and how training data impacts their real-world performance.

zh.title: ToyBlocks：一个专为机器人学习与评估打造的模拟仿真世界
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了名为 **ToyBlocks** 的开源仿真框架，专门用来帮助机器人学习和测试推、翻、叠方块等物理技能。通过将 **受控环境** 与自动任务生成相结合，该框架让科学家能够轻松研究机器人模型为什么成功或失败，以及训练数据如何影响其在真实世界中的表现。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now lets you chop up GPUs to run multiple AI models efficiently
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports **NVIDIA MIG technology**, allowing you to divide a single physical GPU into independent partitions. This means you can run multiple AI models on one GPU with **hardware-level isolation**, avoiding the waste of paying for a whole accelerator when your model only needs a fraction of it.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现在支持切分 GPU，让多个 AI 模型共享运行更省钱
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理现在支持 **GPU 切分技术**，能把一块完整的物理显卡拆成多个独立的小格子。这意味着你可以在一块显卡上同时运行多个 AI 模型，不仅**互不干扰**，还能告别“大马拉小车”的显卡浪费，帮你省下真金白银。

en.title: The AI bubble faces reality after a historic stock market drop
en.summary: The US stock market suffered a historic drop, wiping out **over two trillion** dollars in value as fears of an **AI bubble** grew. This sudden reality check was triggered by political shifts and rising public concerns over the massive **energy and water consumption** of data centers, proving that technological growth cannot ignore physical constraints.

zh.title: 美股大跌敲响警钟，AI泡沫开始面对现实
zh.summary: 美国股市遭遇历史性大跌，蒸发了**数万亿美元**的市值，市场上对**人工智能泡沫**破裂的担忧再度浮现。这场突然的暴跌是由政治变局以及公众对数据中心消耗巨大**能源和水资源**的不满所触发的，给狂热的市场敲响了现实的警钟。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open-source 6G and AI tools, including **Aerial and Sionna**, have seen massive global adoption over the past year. These platforms help researchers build smarter wireless networks that improve robot reaction times, enhance signal reception, and save energy, paving the way for **AI-native 6G connectivity**.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力全球研究人员加速研发下一代6G网络
zh.summary: 过去一年里，英伟达的 **Aerial和Sionna** 等开源6G和AI工具在全球获得广泛应用。这些平台正在帮助研究人员打造更聪明的无线网络，不仅能让机器人反应更快、信号接收更好，还能有效节省能源，为未来的 **AI原生6G网络** 打下坚实基础。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Backup Systems
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Harness-S**, a new training method that helps AI agents learn from mistakes by using multiple backup execution environments. When the standard system fails, the AI tries alternative helper environments to find solutions, and then absorbs those successful problem-solving skills into its **main policy**. Tests show this approach makes AI agents significantly better at handling complex tasks like coding and database operations.

zh.title: Harness-S：用备用执行环境教AI变得更聪明
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的新型训练方法，通过给AI准备多个备用执行环境来帮它减少犯错。当标准系统搞不定任务时，AI会切换到备用帮手环境去寻找出路，并把这些成功的经验全部吸收进自己的 **核心策略** 里。实验表明，这种方法能让AI在处理编程和数据库等复杂任务时变得更厉害。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git worktree manager built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.summary: ⭐ 11,989 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool designed to make Git worktrees as **easy as branches**. It solves the clunky user experience of managing multiple working directories, which is essential when running **5-10+ AI agents** in parallel. Its standout features include streamlined core commands, automated hooks, and shared build caches to save space and time.

zh.title: Worktrunk：专为并行 AI 代理工作流打造的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,989 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，旨在让 Git 工作树像**分支一样简单**。它解决了管理多个工作目录时繁琐的操作体验，这对于同时运行 **5 到 10 个以上 AI 代理**至关重要。它的亮点功能包括精简的核心命令、自动化钩子以及共享构建缓存，从而节省空间和时间。

en.title: Midterm elections deal a blow to data centers and Elon Musk
en.summary: Democrats' recent midterm victories are creating **major roadblocks** for tech companies and their massive data centers. Voters across the U.S. rejected new facilities and elected politicians who promised to restrict them, while Elon Musk saw little return on his massive political donations. In response to the mounting public pressure, companies like OpenAI are starting to drop secrecy and **change their policies**, even trying to rebrand data centers as "compute campuses."

zh.title: 美国中期选举后，数据中心和马斯克迎来了难熬的日子
zh.summary: 民主党人在最近的中期选举中大胜，这给科技巨头及其庞大的数据中心踩下了**急刹车**。全美各地的选民不仅投票反对建设新设施，还选出了承诺限制数据中心的政治人物，而马斯克的大笔政治捐款也没能换来实质回报。面对越来越大的民间压力，OpenAI 等公司开始放弃秘密行事并**修改政策**，甚至试图把“数据中心”改名叫“计算园区”来挽回形象。

en.title: NYT Cooking's new AI assistant is a handy sous chef, but watch out for baking blunders
en.summary: The popular **NYT Cooking** app has added an AI assistant designed to help users substitute missing ingredients, scale portions, and adapt recipes on the fly. While it proves genuinely useful for weeknight improvisations like swapping chicken cuts or vegetables, it can still make mistakes that require human oversight, such as confusing modified ingredient amounts with original ones during baking.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪应用的AI助手：救了我的晚饭，差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 热门的**纽约时报烹饪**应用最近新增了一个AI助手，专门用来帮你替换缺少的食材、调整分量和修改食谱。虽然它在处理诸如替换鸡肉或蔬菜这类日常做饭的临时调整时非常**实用**，但它有时也会犯错，比如在烘焙时把修改后的食材用量和原版搞混，所以人类监督依然**必不可少**。
